StudentPage.title: Student Free Plan
StudentPage.description: Verify your student identity with an education email to unlock all products for free.
StudentPage.upgradeDescription: The automated email verification process is being restructured. For now, we cannot verify directly on this page. If you are a current student, send your school email to
StudentPage.upgradeAction: with a screenshot proving your enrollment (student ID / school email inbox / academic records), and we'll manually issue an invitation code.
StudentPage.upgradeNote: Issued invitation codes are permanently valid and will not be affected by the upgrade.
StudentPage.faq1Answer: Global educational institution emails: .edu, .edu.cn, .ac.uk, .ac.jp, .edu.au, etc. If your school email is not in the supported list, send me an email and I'll manually enable it for you.
StudentPage.faq2Question: Is there a time limit for the discount?
StudentPage.faq2Answer: No. Once verified, it's permanently valid. You can continue using it after graduation.
StudentPage.faq3Question: What if I don't have an education email?
StudentPage.faq3Answer: Send an email directly to meteor@stu.gpnu.edu.cn with a photo of your student ID, and I'll manually enable it for you.

RefundPage.title: Refund Policy
RefundPage.description: Meteor Store Refund Policy and Application Process
RefundPage.intro: This policy applies to digital products purchased directly from Meteor Store. Our products provide downloadable trial versions and detailed documentation. We recommend you try before deciding to pay. Once you receive an activation code and have substantially used the product, due to the replicability of digital products, refunds are generally not provided; but the following exceptions apply.
RefundPage.section1Title: 1. Situations Where Refund Can Be Applied
RefundPage.refund1Desc: If more than 24 hours have passed after successful payment and you still haven't received the activation code or confirmation email, and we are unable to resend, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund2Desc: If the product's core functionality cannot be used normally under standard conditions, and we confirm the issue cannot be fixed or an alternative provided within a reasonable time, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund3Desc: If you have not activated the product (i.e., haven't used the activation code for any login or unlock operation) within 7 days of payment and contact us, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund4Desc: If a duplicate charge for the same order occurred due to system issues, the overcharged amount will be refunded unconditionally in full.
RefundPage.section2Title: 2. Situations Where Refund Is Not Available
RefundPage.noRefund1: The activation code has been activated and used, and does not fall under 'Major Functional Defect' in Section 1 of this policy;
RefundPage.noRefund2: A free trial version was available for verification before purchase, but you express 'not suitable' or 'not needed' after purchase;
RefundPage.noRefund3: Incompatibility due to user environment (OS version, hardware configuration, network conditions, etc.), and the product page or documentation clearly stated the required environment;
RefundPage.noRefund4: Your functional expectations for the product do not match what is clearly stated on the product page / documentation;
RefundPage.noRefund5: Products obtained through invitation codes, discount codes, or gifts (no payment made);
RefundPage.noRefund6: For subscription products that have been used for a period, the remaining portion will be refunded proportionally (if applicable), but the used portion is not refunded.
RefundPage.process1: Send an email to meteor@stu.gpnu.edu.cn with the subject line 'Refund Application + Order Number'.
RefundPage.process2: Briefly explain the reason for the refund in the body, and include the order number, payment time, and payment amount (visible in order details or confirmation email).
RefundPage.process3: If it involves 'Major Functional Defect', please attach a problem description and screenshots for our verification.
RefundPage.process4: We will respond with the review result within 3 business days.
RefundPage.process5: Refunds will be returned through the original payment channel (Alipay), usually within 1-7 business days, depending on the payment channel.
RefundPage.afterRefund1: After a successful refund, the corresponding order's activation code will be immediately deactivated. You must stop using and delete the product copy (except for open source parts).
RefundPage.afterRefund2: After the refund is completed, related invoices or receipts will be simultaneously voided.
RefundPage.afterRefund3: Malicious refund requests (such as requesting a refund after extensive product use, obtaining activation codes and then requesting refunds, etc.) will be rejected, and we reserve the right to pursue legal action if necessary.
RefundPage.section5Content: This policy does not exclude mandatory rights granted to consumers by laws and regulations. If you are a consumer within the People's Republic of China, your rights under the Consumer Protection Law and other laws are not limited by this policy.

PrivacyPage.purpose2: Process your payments and send order confirmations
PrivacyPage.purpose3: Send product updates and service notifications
PrivacyPage.purpose4: Improve user experience and product features
PrivacyPage.purpose5: Prevent fraud and protect account security
PrivacyPage.section3Content: We use Cookies and similar technologies to maintain sessions, remember preferences, and analyze usage. You can manage Cookie preferences through your browser settings.
PrivacyPage.section4Content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information in the following circumstances:
PrivacyPage.share2: To complete payment processing (sharing necessary information with payment service providers)

PrivacyPage.section5Content: We employ industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including transmission encryption (TLS) and access controls. However, please understand that no method of internet transmission is 100% secure.
